name: Baden-Baden (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow, with the city arms of Baden-Baden (a red bend on yellow under a mural crown) towards the hoist; this is the service flag flown on public buildings.
history: Municipal flag of Baden-Baden; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Baden-Baden arms — red bend on yellow with mural crown
